name: iconsect
description: Iconsect: the Claude Code plugin that gives every Grasshopper component a matching icon, rendered from icons.json and embedded in Resources.resx.

plugins.name: iconsect
plugins.description: Gives every Grasshopper component a matching icon. Automates the repeatable parts: previewing the background styles, rendering each icon (shape + optional watermark + Iconify glyph) from icons.json, and embedding them into Resources.resx. You pick the style. Iconsect renders and embeds.
